d: Grand Hyatt Doha is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support the hotel's marketing, branding, and communication initiatives. The role is responsible for designing high-quality visual content that enhances brand awareness, promotes hotel offerings, and ensures consistency with Hyatt brand standards across all digital and printed materials.
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Multimedia Design, Fine Arts, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum 1-2 years of experience in graphic design, preferably within hospitality, luxury brands, advertising agencies, or related industries.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Basic knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva, or other video editing and content creation tools is an advantage.
Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, branding, digital content, and print design capabilities.
Familiarity with social media content creation and digital marketing principles.
Excellent attention to detail, typography, color theory, and layout design.
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
r: li
Design and produce marketing collateral including brochures, flyers, posters, menus, banners, advertisements, and promotional materials.
li
Create engaging visual content for social media platforms, digital campaigns, email marketing, and website updates.
li
Develop creative concepts and layouts that effectively communicate the hotel's brand identity and campaign objectives.
li
Support the creation of graphics for hotel events, seasonal promotions, restaurant campaigns, spa offers, and internal initiatives.
li
Collaborate closely with the Marketing & Communications team and operational departments to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.
li
Coordinate and edit photography and visual assets for marketing use.
li
Assist in the production of multimedia content, including basic video editing, motion graphics, and digital animations when required.
li
Ensure all design work adheres to Hyatt brand guidelines and maintains a consistent brand image.
li
Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality standards.
li
Maintain and organize design files, brand assets, and marketing materials.
li
Stay updated on industry trends, design techniques, and emerging digital platforms to bring fresh ideas to the team.
